name: Pothole Hall
schemaNote: See docs/ogun.md 5.2 to 5.5. Hall x runs 0 to width, floor at groundY. King Pothole is a pit `pit.width` wide whose middle slides between pit.track[0] and pit.track[1]; he freezes while the hero is in the air and slides again `resumeAfterLand` s after landing; he turns back `bumpGap` u before the feet of a hero on the floor. A bag dropped while the hero's middle is over the middle `dropZone` u of the pit, in the air, is a hit. phases[0] is before any hit; one phase per bag, so 3 bags win. Throws come from his near lip, each after a `gulp` warning. gentle.slideScale multiplies every slide speed in Gentle mode.
